Brief review 2026-09-18 (Boat motor cover creative hub) — this brief has 3 errors the editor must know about:
1. the ad text names the store (baverbutiken.se, baverbutiken) — never in copy, on the image, in voice-over or captions (rule since 2026-09-18; ads are mirrored between stores)
2. Store name in the ad: the 22–25 s VO line `Båtmotorskyddet 420D — 579 kr på baverbutiken.se.` and the caption `579 kr. baverbutiken.se` (rule since 2026-09-18: never in copy, image, VO or captions). Next version: end on `Båtmotorskyddet 420D — 579 kr.` and the price alone in the caption.
3. `30 dagars öppet köp.` at 18–22 s — the product page says `Du har 14 dagars ångerrätt enligt lag` and never mentions 30 days (read live from the product page 2026-09-21); free shipping within Sweden, 5–10 working days and Klarna are true (site banner). Replace with a true term (`Fri frakt inom Sverige.`) or drop the line.
Fix before production. If the ad is already live, apply it to the next version — nothing is paused. Status unchanged.
